# Runway Act-Two

> > AI-powered performance capture platform enabling full-body character animation and motion capture directly from webcam input, no equipment required.

Runway Act-Two is an AI animation tool developed by RunwayML that revolutionizes performance capture by tracking facial expressions and full-body movements using only a webcam. The platform eliminates traditional motion capture equipment, making character animation accessible to creators, studios, and animators.
